summary.text: Sam Rasoul is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 38th District since 2014.
The district covers part of the City of Roanoke.
The House profile lists Sam Rasoul as Minority Caucus Secretary (2015-) and as chair of the Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Sam Rasoul was born in Warren, OH.
The profile lists a B.B.A. from Roanoke College (2002) and an M.B.A. from Hawaii Pacific University (2003).
Sam Rasoul's listed occupation is healthcare consultant, and the profile lists military service in the Virginia Defense Force (2007-08).
The profile lists Kiwanis of Roanoke, the Williamson Road Business Association, the NAACP (lifetime member) and Junior Achievement.
Sam Rasoul serves on the Education Committee (as chair), Public Safety, and Health and Human Services.
